name: Doughty Shackle
description: The thrower flings the weights so the cord ends cross and catch in a loose knot about the target's shins.

name: Knotcenter Hasp
description: The thrower pins the cord tail beneath one foot and pulls so the wrapped legs cannot spread.

name: Alert Heavyball
description: The thrower counts the cord's wraps around the target's legs by feel to know whether the snare will hold.

name: Hobbleglide
description: A sliding sidestep keeps the thrower out of the target's reach while the cord is drawn in.

name: Dire Fetter
description: Gripping the cord near the ball, the thrower swings a short hard blow at the opponent's wrist.

name: Clutching Spindle
description: Qi runs along the cord to stiffen it so wrapped legs lock together and resist a straining pull.

name: Hobblescreen
description: A qi-backed cast wraps the ankles twice at once and the thrower cinches them with a single pull.

name: Bolabarrier
description: Weights whirl in a ring about the thrower's torso and keep a lunging foe at the length of the cord.

name: Buttressed Bolaweight
description: The cord sweeps low across the front to knock aside a kick or a cut aimed at the legs.

name: Fetterhurdle
description: The thrower carries the coiled cord over one shoulder and advances with both hands left free.

name: Stubborn Joinknot
description: The thrower catches a returning weight in the palm so a swinging ball cannot strike the thrower's own body.

name: Ruthless Wrapup
description: From the ring guard the thrower looses a single weight at the opponent's face to open an exchange.

name: Ballsling Barrier
description: A flick of the whirling rim sends a thrust sliding off to the thrower's open side.

name: Shielding Cordthree
description: Qi in the cord keeps the whirling ring turning against several blows and bounces each one outward.

name: Entangling Stonehead
description: The whirling cords drop and close about a foe who steps inside the ring and pin both of his arms.

name: Fetterscorer
description: The three cords are gripped in a fan so each weight takes a different line toward the target.

name: Brutal Bindfall
description: The throw aims all three weights at the knee and hip so the cords tangle the joints.

name: Orbflog
description: The heavy central ball is dropped on the opponent's foot as the outer weights swing wide.

name: Kindly Cordfork
description: The thrower tallies by touch which cords still run free and which have wrapped.

name: Tripcord Carapace
description: A low wide stance lets the thrower resist the target's tugging at the tangled cords.

name: Lithe Wrapup
description: The thrower walks a tight spiral around a snared opponent and gathers slack as the circle closes.

name: Wrapuphasp
description: Qi-driven cords climb from the knees to the hips as the target turns and lock both legs and the lower trunk.

name: Fetterprop
description: A throw at the weapon arm wraps the hand and drags the point off its line.

name: Hungry Stonehead
description: Steady qi-backed pulls on the tangled cords keep the target hunched and off balance and wear down his strength.

name: Ember Fetter
description: From a firm seat the rider whirls the weights beside the saddle, ready to cast at a passing target.

name: Comet Shackle
description: The rider throws ahead of a fleeing target at a gallop so the cords meet its legs as it arrives.

name: Sprig Ballsling
description: The rein hand grips the cord's end while the mount's weight does the hauling against a snared runner.

name: Draught Whirlcast
description: A heel cue wheels the mount in a tight turn to keep the quarry on the thrower's cast side.

name: Hum Cordfork
description: Standing braced in the stirrups, the rider knocks a spear point aside with the swinging weights.

name: Sleet Hobble
description: Qi in the cord lets the mount drag a snared quarry's legs together without the line parting.

name: Sleet Bolaweight
description: A qi-driven throw from a charging mount carries the weights far and wraps both hind legs of a fleeing target.

name: Knotcenter Bandage
description: The hunter studies broken grass and scuffed earth to learn where the quarry will run.

name: Orbzip
description: A low quiet crouch brings the hunter within throwing range without startling the quarry into flight.

name: Wrapupslap
description: A flat underhand toss skims the weights ahead of a bounding animal so the cords catch its hocks.

name: Shard Tripcord
description: A short snapped throw drops the weights across the line of a doubling hare to stop it in mid-turn.

name: Binding Bindfall
description: The hunter runs in and ties the snared beast's cord to a post or root before it can thrash free.

name: Rill Heavyball
description: The weights swing up to catch and turn aside the tines of a horned animal that lunges at the hunter.

name: Splice Spindle
description: A qi-backed cast tangles the forelegs of a charging beast so it pitches to the ground short of the hunter.

name: Rill Joinknot
description: Qi in the legs keeps the hunter sure-footed over scree and root as the quarry is run down.

name: Sturdy Cordthree
description: The cord is held taut across the body so the thrower can catch a blade stroke on it.

name: Fetterscreen
description: A flick of the weight wraps the opponent's blade once about the cord and spoils the stroke.

name: Draught Hobble
description: The thrower jabs the held ball straight forward like a fist-stone into the opponent's ribs.

name: Wrapupthwack
description: Backing away, the thrower looses the weights over the shoulder at the pursuer's legs.

name: Sprig Fetter
description: Qi tightens a cord wound about a sword arm and binds blade and wrist together in one pull.

name: Static Bolaweight
description: Right after the bind is slipped, the cord whips back over the opponent's open guard to strike the face.

name: Rough Bindfall
description: The thrower lets the full length of cord slide out in flight so the weights land at the far end of reach.

name: Brawn Tripcord
description: A long rear stride loads the whole body behind the throw so the weights travel as far as the cord allows.

name: Hearty Joinknot
description: The thrower counts the paces to the target and sets the cast length to match.

name: Candorstone
description: The thrower reads a steady sideways drag on the weights and aims a hand's breadth into it.

name: Stonehead Thwack
description: A high lobbing arc lets the weights fall steeply onto a target standing behind low cover.

name: Draught Cordthree
description: The loose tail of a long cord is whipped across an opponent who has closed inside the weights.

name: Brawnstone
description: The thrower walks back along the cord while reeling in the weights and keeps the target in view.

name: Weighty Ballsling
description: A qi-backed throw at full reach wraps the legs hard enough that the target falls before it closes the distance.

name: Draught Heavyball
description: The weights are flung out along the cord to knock a thrown spear from its line.

name: Hobbleslap
description: A qi-driven throw sends the weights to a distant mark and winds the cords about its legs in flight.

name: Stampwrapup
description: One foot planted on the cord's tail pins it to the ground so the snared opponent cannot drag it free.

name: Gall Spindle
description: A toe hooks a trailing cord and flicks it up into the opponent's stepping foot.

name: Rillhobble
description: The thrower plants the heels and drags the body backward, hauling a larger opponent off his feet.

name: Bolabuckle
description: Dropping to a crouch, the thrower lets a swing pass overhead and slips the cord beneath the opponent's guard.

name: Stamp Knotcenter
description: A cord laid on the ground is lifted by a foot and qi-tightened into a loop about the opponent's ankle.

name: Static Cordfork
description: A cord lifted from the dirt whips upward under the opponent's chin before he sees it move.
